summary: Elevate your expertise in inventory and warehouse management with our comprehensive course. Learn strategies to optimize operations and drive efficiency.
lede: Integrated Inventory and Warehouse Management connects demand planning, procurement cycles, stock control, and warehouse execution into one coordinated system. This course shows you how to use safety stock calculations, ABC/XYZ analysis, Economic Order Quantity, cycle counting, and inventory aging reports to turn stock data into actionable decisions. You will also learn to optimize warehouse layouts, apply 5S organization methods, coordinate vendor-managed inventory, and design efficient receiving and dispatch flows. With practical tools such as slotting matrices and quality controls aligned with ISO 9001, the course helps you manage space, labor, traceability, lead times, and order execution more effectively.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for professionals responsible for the physical and financial integrity of stock within the supply chain ecosystem.
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of supply chain concepts and at least one year of experience in a warehouse, logistics, or procurement role. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel for basic data manipulation is required for the calculation exercises.
